codename: Welcome to The New Sci-Fi Interface
title: Beta UI - The New Futuristic AI Interface
label: Internal Alpha
summary: This major release overhauls the VISAR Edge dashboard into a new futuristic AI interface, introducing background multimedia, advanced Avatar states, and experimental Telegram news integration.

sections.title: Added & New Features
items: Added background wallpaper images and interactive intro videos complete with audio.
Integrated Visar_States to the center panel and avatar for dynamic visual feedback.
Implemented a dedicated Message Display for the Warning Layer.
Added new interactive features and controls to the titlebar.
Introduced the Telegram News Update feature (currently marked as unstable/experimental).

sections.title: Improvements & System Redux
items: Completely overhauled the entire VISAR Edge Dashboard from v1.0.0.0 to the new v1.1.0.0 futuristic AI interface.
Updated the UI aesthetics of the visar chatcore starter.py component.
Refactored the feedback system to utilize background threading, preventing UI lockups.

sections.title: Fixes & Security
items: Applied minor fixes to the Tab Transition Animation to ensure smooth visual rendering.

notes: Version 1.1.0.0 establishes the foundational sci-fi aesthetic for the VISAR Edge platform. Please note that the newly introduced Telegram News Update feature is currently in an unstable testing phase.
